scope.title: Argentina, 2013 to latest released observation: partial social Doughnut and ecological evidence
scope.turning_point_status: Provisional working interpretation of the rightward shift: Milei inauguration. Macri 2015 is independently marked.
scope.post_window: First fully post-inauguration periods begin 2024; latest observations vary by indicator. H2 2023 overlaps administrations.
scope.doughnut_scope: Four fixed published social benchmarks only: life expectancy 74, electricity 95, employment 94, equality 70. Equality covers urban second-semester surveys. Ecological series are unscored; no fabricated national planetary ceilings.
scope.causal_status: Descriptive, not causal. No empirical scenario or policy-effect estimate is supplied.
scope.target_version: Fanning et al. 2021 online/2022 issue Table 1; fixed across modern comparison years.
scope.missing_data_policy: No extrapolation, no missing-to-zero, no annual/semester substitution, no post-2015 BAU treated as observation.
